title: 第十三章 好友申请？
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
【领主叶洛璃已报价：1800领主币！】

    看到这个提示消息的同时，那个售卖水系元素石的领主表情都僵住了。

    他作为摆摊的摊主，当然是能看到现在想要购买的双方的信息。

    一个秦天，一个叶洛璃。

    这两人儿，他可都是看到过的！

    不知道他们觉醒了什么样的天赋，反正就是以其他人难以理解的速度迅速发展。

    相比之下，他们其他人更像是菜鸡互啄，这俩人才像是真正要开始发展的。

    但是，这俩人居然为了他的水系元素石，这样争抢？！

    也几乎是在瞬间，他的心中就确定了一件事。

    这东西绝对比自己想的要值钱！

    至少对于现在他们这两人而言是这样的。

    他觉醒的职业普普通通，一般般，吭哧吭哧努力到现在，也就只有两三百领主币而已，每次遇到要用领主币的地方，吭哧瘪肚半天都拿不出来。

    根本就不舍得花钱！！

    好在他运气好，之前在挖掘开采的时候，居然挖掘到了这种罕见的元素石！

    他也只是抱着试试看的心态，想试试这东西能卖什么样的价格，摆了一个自己认为已经很高的价格。

    他挂上来已经有段时间了，一直都没有人购买，不仅如此，连个通过摊位发私聊信息，找他商量价格的人都没有！

    这种情况，已经让他的心中大受打击，甚至都觉得，自己应该是把这个元素石的价格摆的太高了，所以没人买。

    结果他还没来得及对价格进行修改的时候，另外这两位，就把这价格蹭蹭往上抬。

    而且看起来，他们很明显还较量起来了！

    这两个人的价格越抬越离谱，转眼之间就远远超过他一开始的心理预计价格！

    到这一步，他只希望继续，两人继续把价格抬得更高一点！

    两位大佬争东西，就是不一样啊！

    秦天也看到这个价格，都不由得愣了一下。

    不愧是首个击杀凶兽的人，想来应该也是发育的不错，从这个抬价的幅度，其实就已经能看得出来了。

    一下就抬了这么大一截！

    不过...
content_en:
[Lord Ye Luoli has quoted: 1800 lord coins! 】

    When he saw this prompt message, the expression of the lord who sold the water element stone froze.

    As a stall owner, of course he can see the information of both parties who want to buy now.

    One Qin Tian and one Ye Luoli.

    He has seen both of these two people before!

    I don’t know what kind of talent they have awakened, but it is developing rapidly at a speed that is difficult for others to understand.

    In comparison, the rest of them are more like novices pecking each other, and these two seem to be really starting to develop.

    However, these two people actually fought for his water element stone like this? !

    Almost instantly, he was sure of one thing.

    This thing is definitely worth more than I thought!

    At least that's the case for the two of them now.

    The profession he awakened is ordinary, so-so. After all his hard work, he only has two or three hundred lord coins. Every time he encounters a place where lord coins are needed, he can't get them out for a long time.

    Not willing to spend money at all! !

    Fortunately, he was lucky. When he was digging, he actually found this rare elemental stone!

    He just had a try mentality and wanted to see what price this thing could be sold for, so he set a price that he thought was already high.

    He has put it up for a while, but no one has bought it. Not only that, no one has even sent a private message through the stall to discuss the price with him!

    This situation has already hit him hard, and he even felt that he should have set the price of this elemental stone too high, so no one bought it.

    As a result, before he had time to modify the price, the other two people raised the price.

    And it seems that they are obviously competing!

    The price raised by these two people became more and more outrageous, and in the blink of an eye, it far exceeded the price he had initially expected!

    At this point, he just wanted to continue, and the two of them continued to raise the price higher!

    It’s just different for two big guys to fight over something!

    Qin Tian couldn't help but be stunned when he saw the price.

    As expected of being the first person to kill a ferocious beast, he must have developed well. This can actually be seen from the price increase.

    It lifted so much in one go!
